title: Batch Generation Runner
description: New module daud/voyage/batch.py that runs N independent Daud inference sessions per round. Each session gets the same ticket/reference context, a different technique assignment (VOYAGE-1), its own working directory, a hard time budget (30 min), and injected skills (once they exist). Sequential initially with --parallel N flag for later. Uses existing run_inference_loop() with max_rounds=120. Collects results: DSL path, OBJ export, Chamfer fitness, technique used, round count.
definition-of-done: 1. voyage-batch CLI entry point in pyproject.toml. 2. Runs N inference sessions sequentially with different technique assignments. 3. Each session gets isolated working directory. 4. Hard wall-clock timeout per session. 5. Collects DSL, OBJ, Chamfer score, technique for each session. 6. Outputs ranked JSON results.
testing-plan: 1. voyage-batch --reference skull.obj --techniques primitives,curve_sweep produces 2 DSL scripts + OBJ exports + Chamfer scores. 2. Verify timeout kills a stuck session. 3. Verify results JSON contains all expected fields.
todos: Implement batch runner with technique rotation
